e: Fourteen military personnel are killed in a boating accident during an exercise in the Caspian Sea off Aktau.
The Rock Mosques and Associated Sacred Sites of Mangystau are designated as UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
The United States imposes a 12.5% tariff on Kazakhstan, citing the presence of alleged forced labor in the supply chain.
The new Constitution of Kazakhstan comes into effect.
Two 13-year-old boys fatally stab a 12-year-old in Almaty.
Russia signs a $16.5 billion agreement to build the first nuclear power plant in Kazakhstan.
The Astana Light Metro begins operations.
Nineteen activists are convicted and sentenced to up to five years' imprisonment for staging a protest in 2025 against Chinese repression in Xinjiang.
Seven people are killed in an explosion at a café in Shchuchinsk, Akmola Region.
A Sukhoi Su-30 of the Kazakh Air Defense Forces crashes during a training flight in Karaganda Region. Both pilots safely eject.
A tenth-grader injures two students with an axe at a school in Kulsary, Atyrau Region.
